text:
MR::available_for_routing
Description
This command command gets or sets the available_for_routing mode for the current connection.
Syntax
MR
::
available_for_routing
[
boolean
]
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
MR
::
available_for_routing
no
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANY
Introduced: BIGIP-16.1.0
